text:
lexa-design: dropped a tiny Figma link -> https://figma.com/file/ux/rail-refactor-proto. Proposal: group left rail into three anchors (Models | Serve | Insights), add subtle permalink icon on rows. need quick sanity check on deep-link landing semantics + back-button/scroll behavior. :eyes:
ajay-ux: high level: love the grouping. UX Q: when someone opens a deep link like /workspaces/:ws/models/:m1?tab=versions should we expand the Models group and focus the nested panel, or mount the detail view and keep groups collapsed? which gives the most predictable back/forward behavior?
sam-frontend: prefer canonical nested URLs so everything is bookmarkable. client contract sketch:
/workspaces/:ws/models/:modelId
/workspaces/:ws/models/:modelId?tab=versions
/workspaces/:ws/serve/instances/:instId
Behavior: on direct load expand parent group (no entrance animation), scroll item into view, then focus the panel heading (tabindex=-1 + focus()). On in-app nav pushState({scrollY: window.scrollY, openGroup: 'models', tab: 'versions'}, '', href); on popstate restore scroll and expand state. Need tests for direct load vs SPA nav and SSR paths.
kelly-pm: copy/taxonomy nit: let's standardize on "Models" everywhere (not "Model registry"). breadcrumbs must be humanized: "Acme Co • Models • MyModel" not raw param names. also please add a tiny permalink affordance on each row so PMs can share exact links.
mike-a11y: a11y checklist: 1) group headers role=button + aria-expanded. 2) when we programmatically expand announce via aria-live="polite": e.g., "Models expanded, 5 items". 3) when deep-link opens a nested panel move focus to panel heading so AT reads context. 4) permalink button needs aria-label="Copy link to model", keyboard focusable, 24px hit target, visible focus ring and announce "Link copied to clipboard" via aria-live.
routebot: route-lint-bot: failing specs detected -> history-restore.tests failing for /workspaces/:ws/models flow. CI job #4782.
lexa-design: plan: 1) sam to open PR implementing history-state + tests. 2) mike to write a11y acceptance text (announce strings + focus rules). 3) design to update Figma copy to "Models" and add permalink icon variant. 4) QA to add back-button scroll restore test. I'll file GH issues and link them here. thanks! :party_parrot:
